title: Hisense — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Hisense.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Smart Value." Hisense is the Chinese electronics giant rapidly expanding in North American appliances. They own Gorenje and ASKO in Europe. In North America, Hisense-branded appliances target the value-to-mid-range with features that punch above their weight — French door refrigerators under $1,500 with features matching $2,000 Samsung/LG models. Growing fast in the big-box channel.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Value-conscious buyers who want features without the brand premium. Big-box shoppers comparing specs.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Hisense:

• Features that match Samsung/LG at 20-30% lower prices

• Rapidly improving quality backed by massive global R&D investment

• Owns ASKO and Gorenje — has access to premium European technology

• Growing market share proves the value proposition is real

• Full kitchen packages at prices competitors cannot match
